Review baseline: release/3.0 at fb5b59bda429b7545f82072dabe10f8b299432dc.
Classification: review-confirmed defect.

Source task: 01a09c57-210c-79f0-9e9f-669bbeed6dfc

1. **P1 — Reviewed packs ignore their filters.**  
   [catalog.ex:359](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/catalog.ex:359) applies only the allow-list. A pack with `filters: %{risk: :write}` and the read action `"catalog.item.get"` returns no normal items, but `reviewed_items/2` returns a fingerprinted read item. A pack with only `type: :action` also fails if its provider has triggers. Apply the same pack filters to the exact supplied modules before selection and fingerprint generation. Existing reviewed tests use matching filters and allow-lists, which conceal this defect.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.

comments.text: Fixed on release/3.0 in da5f897a. The new test failed on the original reviewed selection and passes after applying pack filters before action selection. Fresh v3 mix quality passed; demo format, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 tests passed. No jido_mcp changes.

title: Reviewed packs ignore their filters
